page_title: NAN 0-0 TOU | Nantes v Toulouse 27/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' That's unlucky! Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.
90+2' A yellow card for a tackle by Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse). Florent Batta doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90+2' The resulting set piece from Nantes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post.
86' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) meets a fine cross on the edge of the box from the resulting corner kick and shoots. His shot flies just wide of the left post.
85' The ball goes out of play and Nantes have been awarded a corner kick.
82' Here is a change. Frank Magri is going off and Carles Martinez gives the last tactical orders to Shavy Babicka (Toulouse).
80' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) gets a yellow card.
80' A yellow-coloured card is received by Nicolas Cozza (Nantes).
77' The manager makes a subsitution with Meschack Elia (Nantes) coming on for Matthis Abline.
77' Antoine Kombouare prepares a substitution. Kelvin Amian is replaced by Fabien Centonze (Nantes).
75' Substitution. Joshua King is replaced by Yann Gboho (Toulouse).
74' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) commits a rough foul. Florent Batta stops the game and makes a call.
72' The corner from Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) is hurriedly cleared.

72' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Corner kick. Toulouse will have an opportunity.
68' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) makes a rough challenge and Florent Batta blows his whistle for a foul.
66' Antoine Kombouare has decided to make a change. Tino Kadewere (Nantes) replaces Nicolas Pallois.
66' The game has come to an end for Moses Simon. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes).
64' Carles Martinez is stunned as referee Florent Batta shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
61' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Matthis Abline (Nantes), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.

59' A decent save by Anthony Lopes. Frank Magri (Toulouse) finds some space near the penalty spot to meet a cross and head it down to the middle of the goal, but the effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
57' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) was too forceful with his tackle and Florent Batta interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
53' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
50' The corner is swung in but Toulouse can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
50' Toulouse have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

50' Frank Magri (Toulouse) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Anthony Lopes leaps like a salmon to deny him. The linesman makes the right call and Toulouse will have a corner.
48' Joshua King (Toulouse) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
46' Here comes a substitution. Douglas Augusto is given a rest as he is replaced by Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' Florent Batta has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' Nantes work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
45+5' A loose pass is instantly latched onto by Douglas Augusto (Nantes). He tries his luck from the edge of the box with a measured shot, but it hits the right post and is cleared to safety.
45+3' It looks like Kelvin Amian (Nantes) saw red with that tackle. Florent Batta won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
43' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
39' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Noah Edjouma (Toulouse) has to leave the pitch!
39' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Noah Edjouma (Toulouse)! Let's see what he decides.
38' Florent Batta shows a yellow card to Noah Edjouma (Toulouse) for a tough tackle.
35' Joshua King (Toulouse) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
33' Frank Magri (Toulouse) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
28' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) works the corner short.
26' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) sees a yellow card from Florent Batta after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
20' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
18' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
13' Toulouse can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

12' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Toulouse have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
9' Florent Batta shows the yellow card to Jaydee Canvot (Toulouse) for a heavy challenge.

4' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Florent Batta with no other option than to blow for a foul.
2' Rough tackle by Pedro Chirivella (Nantes). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Nantes will kick the game off.
Florent Batta will supervise the game today.
